name: instructional-designers-pack
description: Claude for Instructional Designers: 32 Claude skills for building one course from the request to the release, in eight stages: scope the course with the brief, the learner analysis, an action mapping session and an estimate the sponsor signs; get the content from experts with the interview script, the source triage and the review plan; design it with measurable objectives, the design document, the course map and the assessment blueprint; write the branching scenarios, the storyboard, video scripts, questions and job aids; build a practice activity, slides, a short series or a live session moved on screen; check accuracy, whether it teaches, accessibility, your own run-through, the expert round and a learner pilot; ship with a sign-off record and a release note and read the data; then keep your own practice in order. For instructional designers, learning experience designers, e-learning developers and the L&D person who builds courses alone. Claude drafts and checks; you decide what the learner needs, and a named person signs it off.
